summary: Focused fresh review confirms both original P1 repairs, including wrong-key writes after final-value deletion/restart and safe native target rejection. One new P1 remains: ordinary Node object diagnostics of a multiline Secret bypass exact-form redaction and persist the reconstructable credential in run, execution, events and inspection. Both separate Standards and Spec passes independently confirmed the representation mismatch.

findingResolutions.evidence: Persistent AES-GCM vault verifier authenticates existing key before new encrypted writes and survives deleting all value records. Independent temporary-store checks reject missing/wrong-key create and replacement without changing variables, counters, vault, ciphertext or bindings; reject wrong key after final deletion and close/reopen; restoring original key permits recovery. Added migration fallback authenticates a retained envelope before verifier creation; targeted tests pass.

The separately identified multiline object representation is tracked under new id 562671e-node-inspected-multiline.

findings.details: [P1] Scrub multiline Node-inspected values when embedded in ordinary object diagnostics. Added variants use inspect(value), whose continuation lines are indented two spaces, and a compact full-value form. Normal console.error({token:process.env.TEST_TOKEN}) formats a long multiline Secret as quoted pieces with four-space continuation indentation; nested objects add more. Neither variant nor the raw/JSON-escaped full string matches, so every credential segment remains. Independent native Script reproduction with a fake two-line Secret persists the complete reconstructable value in run.error, execution.error, node.failed events and engine.inspect. This is standard Node logging, without a custom transformation, and violates D3 stderr/error masking, AC3 and AC7 as well as the revised architecture promise. Handle native object/multiline diagnostic formatting before history and add the reachable native regression. Proof /tmp/interlock-variables-review-562671e-proof.{mts,json,log}; both separate reviewers independently reproduced the representation miss.
